caption: The video captures a blacksmithing scene in a dim workshop backed by a dark brick wall, with a metal drum at the left and a vertical power hammer at the center. A man in a grey shirt and a yellow protective glove leans over the machine, gripping a glowing orange-hot billet with long tongs on the anvil die. The cylindrical ram of the hammer hangs just above the workpiece, which stays incandescent throughout. Two spare tongs and metal rods lie on the worktable in the foreground. As the sequence runs, the ram shifts slightly up and down over the billet without visibly contacting it. Between these movements the smith's gloved hand adjusts the tongs, repositioning the billet on the die. His head and torso tilt subtly as he watches and feeds the work under the tool. The background elements remain fixed, indicating an essentially static camera. The forging process is already underway at the start of the clip and continues to the end, with the billet still bright.
